name: Ferienwohnung Elisabeth
beschreibung: The Holiday Apartment Elisabeth is located in the center of Bad Häring, a small spa town in the Tiroler Unterland. The house is situated in a quiet residential area and offers direct access to the local hiking trails and the public thermal spa. Guests can expect a functionally furnished holiday apartment with a kitchen, balcony, and view of the surrounding meadows. Public transport connections make excursions to the surrounding ski and hiking areas possible. Parking spaces are available at the house.
